rationale: All three lenses ran (blind, edge-case, acceptance) with a spec present; acceptance found 21/21 criteria pass with zero fail/partial. Blind lens raised 7 observations, all non-blocking (a maintainability suggestion to comment the intentional fileUrl/strippedFileUrl asymmetry, and pre-existing edge cases the diff does not regress). Edge-case lens raised 6 items, all dismissed: 4 of them recommend using strippedFileUrl in HTTP request paths, which directly contradicts the approved spec's explicit requirement that requests must carry the full, unstripped fileUrl/fileId so the backend can authorize the share-token download; the other 2 concern an empty-string-after-strip case that already resolves safely today (atob('') does not throw in either decodeFileName implementation) and is unchanged pre-existing behavior. 0 patch/decision_needed findings, 0 defer, 13 dismiss.
